package.name: quadrotor_msgs
package.description: The frozen PLAN-box -> BRIDGE command interface, vendored: `PositionCommand` on `/plan/cmd`. A msg-only copy of ego-planner-swarm's `quadrotor_msgs` (uav_simulator/Utils/quadrotor_msgs at 23a8d5a), pinned by SHA-256 in PROVENANCE.txt. Read README.md: this package exists so that the interface outlives any one planner, and it deliberately depends on nothing but the three standard message packages.
